purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Kwanza Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered at 120 DPI (3-page official IEBC Form 34B PDF; page 2 of 3 is the polling-station table page whose final row is labelled TOTAL, in grey shading). Re-read against the form's own printed Aggregate Results and Voter Turnout summary boxes lower on the same page, which match exactly.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image, then independently cross-confirmed against the form's own printed Aggregate Results and Voter Turnout summary tables on the same page. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.
